normalization.rule: retain exact source bytes, physical record number, every raw field string, parsed integer sensitivity values, and policy version; no row is removed or rewritten

scopes.rule: Decimal(raw transposable) == Decimal(1); observed raw member value is exactly 1.0
trimmed case-folded raw taxonomy is neither empty nor Unknown

semantic_dimensions.name: tagged
semantic_dimensions.value: unresolved user/source term; no generic tagged scope exists

semantic_dimensions.name: transposable
semantic_dimensions.value: raw binary source field; Phigaro v2.3 candidate algorithm detects a pattern of Integration-group pVOG annotations, not completeness/quality

semantic_dimensions.name: taxonomy_labels
semantic_dimensions.value: raw class-like strings only; Phigaro v2.3 candidate produces tied modal pVOG taxonomy codes and Unknown when none map

semantic_dimensions.name: strand_orientation
semantic_dimensions.value: unknown; forward genomic spelling only after coordinate resolution; never infer strand

semantic_dimensions.name: topology_and_circularity
semantic_dimensions.value: source has no topology, origin-wrap, or ordered-interval marker; do not infer from begin<=end

semantic_dimensions.name: contig_edge_behavior
semantic_dimensions.value: source does not declare clipping, extension, truncation, or edge callability

semantic_dimensions.name: completeness
semantic_dimensions.value: no source completeness field; edge and length diagnostics are not completeness labels

semantic_dimensions.name: duplicate_locus_rules
semantic_dimensions.value: producer handling unknown; this snapshot has zero duplicate (genome,scaffold,begin,end) groups and policy preserves every row without deduplication

test_plan: obtain digest-pinned producer/caller version and exact post-processing provenance
verify version-matched native TSV against native BED/GFF and saved FASTA on a declared known-base fixture
for each frozen sentinel assert first/last expected base, length=end-begin+1, whole-slice digest, contig bounds, edge/wrap state
require independent exact-source/canonical base round-trip before selection
